_readme: Upcoming dated events: Parents Night Out, belt testing, demos, camps, anything with a date. Add one object per date to "events". Fields: kind ("parents-night-out", "belt-testing", "demo", or "other"), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), startTime and endTime (24-hour HH:MM, Eastern time), price (as it should read, e.g. "$25 per child", or "Free"; leave "" to hide), description (one or two sentences), bookingLink (where people sign up: e.g. "/contact?interest=parents-night-out" or a full URL; leave "" to send them to the contact page). Past events hide themselves. Example: { "kind": "parents-night-out", "title": "Parents Night Out: Nerf Night", "date": "2026-11-14", "startTime": "18:00", "endTime": "21:00", "price": "$25 per child", "description": "Nerf battles, games, and martial arts.", "bookingLink": "/contact?interest=parents-night-out" }
